exposure: Women with obstetric fistula after delivery
cohort: Women with obstetric fistula treated at the National Treatment Center for Gynecologic Fistulas, Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen, Norway
finding: Obstetric fistula has a low incidence in Norway and is primarily caused by obstetric trauma or surgery, with excellent treatment outcomes achieved at a specialized center.
mod_finding: Urinary fistulas were caused by cesarean section, cerclage, and uterine rupture, while enteral fistulas were all related to vaginal deliveries, with 25% involving instrument use and 53% experiencing a perineal tear of grade 3-4.
